ContextBranch.name: X-Branch-Id
ContextBranch.description: Optional branch of the request. The branch's public reference (UUID) inside the active company (the `id` of the branch pickers). Without it the request acts for the whole company (all branches the caller is eligible for). On the owner report and dashboard operations the `branch_id` query parameter (a branch reference) is taken as this header; a sent header always wins. A branch outside the company or the caller's eligibility is `INVALID_CONTEXT` (403).

ContextBranchRequired.name: X-Branch-Id
ContextBranchRequired.description: Active branch of the request: the branch's public reference (UUID) inside the active company. Required at branch scope; when the header is absent, a branch reference sent as `branch_id` (query or body) is used instead. Missing both is `CONTEXT_REQUIRED` (400); a branch outside the company or the caller's eligibility is `INVALID_CONTEXT` (403).

ContextCompany.name: X-Company-Id
ContextCompany.description: Active company of the request: the company's public reference (UUID). The server keeps no "current company": every request names it, and it is checked against the caller's active membership and scope eligibility. When the header is omitted and the caller is eligible for exactly one company, that company is used (`default_single_company`); with none or several eligible companies the request is refused with `CONTEXT_REQUIRED` (400). A company the caller may not act in is `INVALID_CONTEXT` (403). On the owner dashboard, `organization_reference` names the company card shown, not the context.

ContextTenant.name: X-Tenant-Id
ContextTenant.description: Tenant public reference (UUID). Optional: the tenant is derived from the active company; when sent it must name that company's tenant, else `INVALID_CONTEXT` (403).

ContextTenantRequired.name: X-Tenant-Id
ContextTenantRequired.description: Active tenant of the request: the tenant's public reference (UUID), checked against the caller's active membership. Missing is `CONTEXT_REQUIRED` (400).

PostingRequestStatus.description: Lifecycle of a durable accounting posting request. - RECEIVED: recorded, not processed yet (or a transient failure awaiting retry). - POSTED: exactly one journal entry was posted for it (terminal). - PENDING_CONFIGURATION: a role has no valid company mapping, or no fiscal   period covers the posting date; the automatic run re-checks it. - FAILED: unexpected error; retried automatically until the attempt cap. - BLOCKED_CLOSED_PERIOD: the posting date is in a closed period. Never   retried or reprocessed automatically; released only by the authorized   closed-period correction (OWN-DEC-008). - BLOCKED_VAT_LOCKED (A-05): a VAT-changing posting dated in a period whose   VAT return is filed (VatLockPolicy). Never picked up automatically;   released only by the authorized correction into an unlocked date. - REJECTED: the request itself is invalid (unbalanced, no lines, tenant   mismatch, foreign account...). Never posted; the producer must correct it.
PostingRequestStatus.title: PostingRequestStatus
